description.subtitle: Short trousers of the third adidas equipment of Real Madrid 2026 2027 - pink
description.tagline: Completes the third equipment of Real Madrid
description.intro: The Short adidas 3rd Real Madrid 26 27 celebrates the Madrid legacy with a renewed aesthetic inspired by Latin American culture that defines the third team of the season. Its pink design combines identity, comfort and performance for both footballers and amateurs. It is made of resistant interlock fabric and has a waistband with cord to adapt the grip to your preferences.
key_benefits: Freshness during effort: Manage sweat to help you keep a feeling dry and comfortable.
Custom fit: The waistband with cord allows easy adjustment of the grip.
Comfort in motion: Designed to accompany you during games and trainings.
Durable fabric: Its interlock construction offers a suitable clothing for sporty use.
Madrid style: Complete the pink design of the third equipment of Real Madrid 2026 2027.

Está confeccionado en resistente tejido interlock y dispone de cintura con cordón para adaptar la sujeción a tus preferencias.
key_benefits: Frescura durante el esfuerzo: Gestiona el sudor para ayudarte a mantener una sensación seca y cómoda.
Ajuste personalizado: La cintura con cordón permite regular fácilmente la sujeción.
Comodidad en movimiento: Diseñado para acompañarte durante partidos y entrenamientos.
Tejido resistente: Su construcción interlock ofrece una confección adecuada para el uso deportivo.
Estilo madridista: Completa el diseño rosa de la tercera equipación del Real Madrid 2026 2027.
